title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Iron Straight Bar | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom organization with an 18-Inch wall mount towel bar that brings the Pipeline collection’s pipe-fitting look to everyday towel storage.

  • Pipeline collection styling: industrial-inspired design that complements transitional bathroom hardware
  • Durable construction: powder-coated iron for a clean, decorative finish
  • Space-saving install: wall mount design helps keep floor space clear
  • Complete mounting kit: includes mounting plates and color-coordinated installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs

  • Center-to-center: 18 inches
  • Overall length: 18 inches
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 inch
  • Projection: 3.3 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 18 in L x 3 in H x 3.3 in W
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Included items: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware

Designed as part of the coordinated Pipeline collection, this towel bar is available in multiple designer finish options so you can match your bathroom hardware.

_previous.description: The Pipeline collection is the latest innovation for bathroom fittings from the Allied Brass Brand of products. This towel bar gives the industrial look of pipe fittings while blending aptly with both modern and traditional bathroom decor. This accessory is powder coated with lifetime materials to provide a decorative and clean finish. No wonder, this towel bar gives continual service for years without any trouble. The choice of superior materials makes this item free from corrosion and rust. Towel bar mounts firmly with color coordinating screws and comes with a limited lifetime warranty.
